articles.summary: NEW YORK, April 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Chicago Atlantic BDC, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: LIEN), a specialty finance company that has elected to be regulated as a business development company, today announced details for the release of its financial results for the first quarter of 2026.
articles.title: Chicago Atlantic BDC, Inc. Announces Date for First Quarter 2026 Results Release and Conference Call
